create_document.description: Queue a document for generation without waiting for it, or save it as a draft. Use this for large batches, then check on it later; to get the file in one step, use 'Generate a document' instead.
create_document.display_str_template: Create a PDFMonkey document from template {0}.
create_document.name: create_document

parameters.description: The PDFMonkey template to generate from. Pick one of your templates, or use a template ID from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.description: The fields and values that fill in the template's placeholders, for example the customer name or order total. An object, or its JSON text.
parameters.name: payload

parameters.description: Name for the generated file, for example 'invoice-1042'. PDFMonkey adds the right extension itself. Leave empty to let PDFMonkey name it.
parameters.name: filename

parameters.description: Optional extra details to store with the document, for example an order reference. They come back with the document, so a later step can read them. An object, or its JSON text.
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.description: Start generating the document straight away. Turn this off to save it as a draft and generate it later with 'Update a document'.
parameters.name: generate

parameters.description: Lock the PDF so it opens only with this password. Leave empty for no password. Images can't be locked.
parameters.name: password

parameters.description: For a template that makes images: the format to make. PDFMonkey makes WebP when this is empty. Ignored for PDFs.
parameters.name: image_format

parameters.description: For a template that makes images: the width in pixels, instead of the template's own. Ignored for PDFs.
parameters.name: image_width

parameters.description: For a template that makes images: the height in pixels, instead of the template's own. Ignored for PDFs.
parameters.name: image_height

parameters.description: For a WebP image: the quality from 1 to 100. PDFMonkey uses 100 when this is empty.
parameters.name: image_quality

document_id.description: The ID of the document in PDFMonkey.

document_status.description: Where the document is in the generation process: "draft", "pending", "generating", "success", or "failure".

download_url.description: PDFMonkey's link to download the finished file. Empty until the document is ready, and it stops working an hour after it is issued.

failure_reason.description: Why generation failed, when the document failed to generate.

meta.description: The extra details stored with the document, including its file name under _filename. A PDF password is never shown here.

output_type.description: The kind of file the template produces: "pdf" or "image".

preview_url.description: Link for previewing the document in a browser.

public_share_link.description: Permanent public link to the file. Only set on PDFMonkey plans with share links (Pro+, Premium and the trial).

template_id.description: The ID of the template the document was generated from.

template_name.description: The name of that template, as shown in PDFMonkey.

updated_at.description: When the document was last updated.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the PDFMonkey workspace the document belongs to.

create_template.description: Create a template from HTML and CSS, with its page settings, ready to generate documents from. The HTML can hold Liquid placeholders that each document fills in.

parameters.description: The template's name, as shown in PDFMonkey (up to 100 characters).

parameters.description: How long PDFMonkey keeps the documents made from this template before deleting them. A period your plan doesn't allow becomes its longest.
